reviewer.verification: Current worker session_meta and turn_context records; no additional model or subagent launched.

scope: Independent complete semantic/diff review of two existing common-inventory display IDs only. No other text translation or release acceptance.

inputs.glossaryEvidence: Complete bounded relevant glossary context read in packet; full glossary not reread.

checks: Packet units exactly equal targets; two distinct stable IDs.
Whole canonical source inventory SHA256 matches pinned packet fingerprint.
Both IDs match source text, source-value hash and all supplied source identity/consumer fields.
Source-value SHA256 uses UTF-8 JSON string serialization, including quotes.
deterministicValidation.boundary: Input identity/source binding only; not whole-game preservation or runtime behavior.
deterministicValidation.validationAttemptAccounting: Initial validation assumed raw-string hash encoding and stopped before writing any file. JSON-string encoding matched both existing source-value hashes; validation was corrected and passed.

decisions.semanticReview: Загляни к Скарлетт naturally conveys Check in with Scarlett in the supplied visit/greeting quest context and retains direction and character identity.
decisions.russianReview: Natural informal singular imperative; Скарлетт is correctly indeclinable after к. Consistent with accepted Снова загляни к Скарлетт without adding the source-absent again.
decisions.technicalReview: Complete display string with no placeholders, markup, escapes or internal technical operands. Terminal period and previousStepText binding preserved.

decisions.source: Say hi to four more critters.
decisions.semanticReview: Поздоровайся conveys Say hi; ещё explicitly retains more/additional and четырьмя retains exactly four additional critters. зверушками follows the approved critter term.
decisions.russianReview: Natural informal singular imperative matching the quest UI. Поздоровайся с takes the instrumental; четырьмя зверушками has correct agreement. ещё clearly marks the additional group.
decisions.technicalReview: Complete display string with no placeholders, markup, escapes or internal technical operands. Terminal period and currentStepText binding preserved.

contextAndRegressionReview.questTransition: Previous step checks in with Scarlett; current step greets four additional residents. Arguments are not swapped.
contextAndRegressionReview.registerAndGlossary: Informal singular imperative, indeclinable Скарлетт, critter → зверушка.
contextAndRegressionReview.amountRegression: Target retains additional four, rather than all four or an unspecified number.
contextAndRegressionReview.technicalBoundary: Packet states both display arguments are enqueued unchanged by QuestUpdatedUI.ShowNotification. Neighboring greetingsquest_critter_introduced_* comparison operands remain protected and outside these replacement strings. Review does not claim a fresh IL audit or whole-game exact-preservation check.

usage.measurement: Latest cumulative counters for this fresh no-history worker only. Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning is a subset of output.
usage.reportingTail: Receipt-writing request and output after cutoff, including final report, are unmeasured here. No monetary cost inferred.
